title: Missed delivery
text: If you're not there when the courier arrives, they'll wait a few minutes and then move on. You can request a same-day redelivery or reschedule it from the order screen in the Zapp app. After two failed attempts, the order is returned and refunded to your original payment method.
questions: What happens if I miss my delivery?
Can I request a redelivery if I'm not home when the courier arrives?
How long will the courier wait before leaving my package?
Will I get a refund if my order is returned after two missed attempts?
